title: QuiverAI (Arrow 2)
brief: QuiverAI's platform and API powering Arrow 2 for generating and editing clean, layered SVG vector graphics and animations from text prompts or reference images, with web canvas, SDK, and MCP integrations.
details: An X announcement from QuiverAI for Arrow 2 — their latest models for generating precise, editable vector graphics, a notable data point in AI vector-graphics generation where editability (not just raster output) is the hard part.
